prior_hypothesis: multi-display ClientToScreen/SetCursorPos coordinate virtualization for a WebView host on a non-primary display (recorded by run phase 110 as an unproven hypothesis)
proven_cause: Stale topmost Windows Error Reporting crash dialogs (WerFault.exe, class #32770, window title "Python") spawned by crashed python.exe processes occupy the packaged smoke frame's WebView centre click point and reclaim foreground at the moment of the synthetic left click.
measurement_method: Non-destructive 10ms GetForegroundWindow poller (.tmp/w57-repair-111/fg_watch.py) running concurrently with the UNMODIFIED maintained harness scripts/wx_packaged_smoke.py. No input was sent and no window state was changed by the watcher.

geometric_confirmation.note: SendInput delivers the left click to the topmost window at the cursor position, not to the intended frame, so the click never reaches the xterm WebView. This is a desktop-contamination effect, not a coordinate-virtualization effect and not a product defect.
